native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 1.1, 'state': {'sevseg1': '2'}, 'description': 'After 1.1 seconds, the timer has incremented by 2 seconds (since it increments by 2 per real second). The timer value is 2, which is less than 10, so the full value 2 is displayed on the 7-segment display.'}

test2: {'time': 3.1, 'state': {'sevseg1': '6'}, 'description': 'After 3.1 seconds, the timer has incremented by 6 seconds. The timer value is 6, which is less than 10, so the full value 6 is displayed on the 7-segment display.'}

test3: {'time': 6.1, 'state': {'sevseg1': '2'}, 'description': 'After 6.1 seconds, the timer has incremented by 12 seconds. Since the timer value exceeds 10, only the last digit (2) is displayed on the 7-segment display.'}
